title: In-console usage insights (route + model cost breakdown, top drivers, exports) — Beta → GA initiative
creator: Paula Mendes
description:
Context
Customers and internal teams are asking for reliable, explainable cost attribution inside the Console. Today, billing totals exist, but developers cannot quickly answer: “What route/model is driving spend?”, “What changed week-over-week?”, or “Can I export this for finance/chargeback?”

This initiative delivers “In-console usage insights” that:
- Breaks down usage + cost by API route and model (with optional dimensions: deployment mode, region, workspace/project)
- Surfaces top cost drivers and “what changed?” insights with explainability
- Supports exports (CSV) and shareable reports with RBAC, consistent totals vs billing

Primary personas
- Engineering leads / platform owners: find cost drivers, correlate with latency and request patterns, and take action.
- FinOps / finance partners: reconcile totals, export for spend analysis, and internal chargeback.
- Solutions/support: troubleshoot discrepancies quickly with consistent definitions.

In scope (MVP → Beta)
1) Cost/usage breakdown tables
- Group by: route + model (with model family/version bucketing)
- Driver fields: tokens in/out, cache hit/miss, streaming overhead, retries, fallbacks, context length distribution, latency-correlated spend
- Filters: time range, workspace/project, env, region, deployment mode, route, model
- Drill-down: route/model → time series and request characteristics (where available)

2) “Top cost drivers” + “What changed?”
- Rankings: largest cost contributors, largest deltas WoW
- Explanations: token out increase, model mix shift, cache hit rate drops, retries/fallbacks increases, context length shift
- Guardrails to avoid misleading insights (e.g., low sample sizes, partial data, late events)

3) Export + shareable reports
- CSV export with stable column definitions and rounding rules
- Async export jobs for large ranges; limits + throttling
- Signed download URLs; audit logging (download + share link access)
- RBAC and workspace setting to hide cost data

4) Correctness + governance
- Reconciliation checks vs billing totals within tolerance
- Freshness indicators and partial-data warnings (aggregation lag / late events)
- Retention alignment and restricted workspace controls

Out of scope (initial release)
- Fully automated optimization actions (only recommendations/links)
- Scheduled email reports
- Per-customer custom dimensions beyond a fixed set

Milestones (target)
Phase 0 — Discovery + data audit (complete)
- Validate telemetry fields needed for route/model attribution, identify gaps, propose instrumentation changes.
- Owner(s): Logan Wright, Nadia Rahman, Allison Grant

Phase 1 — Aggregation dataset + query API + initial Console tables (in progress)
- Aggregated dataset keyed by workspace/project + time bucket + canonical route + model bucket
- Query endpoints + pagination + caching
- Console UI: breakdown table + filters + drilldowns (table-first)

Phase 2 — Drivers + export + RBAC + performance hardening (planned / partially in progress)
- Top drivers computation + “what changed?” deltas with explainability strings
- CSV export jobs + signed URLs + audit events
- RBAC gating + workspace cost visibility setting
- Query latency improvements (materialized views / pre-aggregation / caching)

Phase 3 — Beta rollout + validation + docs + launch comms (planned)
- Feature flag + allowlist
- Correctness validation vs billing (tolerance policy)
- Docs/help center + troubleshooting + known issues
- Release note + internal enablement (Support/SE/CS playbooks)

Beta criteria (must-have)
- Route + model breakdown available for 7/30 day ranges for beta allowlist accounts
- Totals reconcile to billing within tolerance (documented)
- Export CSV works for 30-day range within size limits; async job path tested
- RBAC: non-authorized users cannot view cost or export; audit logs emitted for exports/downloads
- Freshness indicators show last-aggregated timestamp; partial-data banner on lag
- Known issues documented (incl. route normalization edge cases and model aliasing)

GA criteria (exit beta)
- Correctness: drift vs billing totals within tolerance across 95%+ of workspaces over 4 weeks; automated alerts for regression
- Performance: interactive queries meet p95 latency SLOs for common filters; timeouts addressed for long ranges
- Data quality: missing route tags in any region < 0.5% of events (or clearly flagged); late events handled consistently
- Support readiness: playbook, FAQs, and escalation paths; clear “how to interpret” docs
- Security sign-off for RBAC/export/audit logging; retention controls verified in restricted workspaces

Risks / open questions
- Cardinality explosion: route normalization needs tight templating + guardrails; fallback to “(unattributed)” buckets when necessary.
- Model aliasing/version bucketing: must prevent duplicate rows and align with billing model IDs.
- Streaming attribution: ensure route tags exist for streaming endpoints in all regions; define “streaming overhead” consistently.
- Retries/fallback semantics: ensure definitions match what engineers expect and what billing uses.
- Freshness vs accuracy tradeoff: communicate aggregation lag/late events without undermining trust.

Activity log (high-level)
2026-01-08 — Kickoff
- Confirmed goal: route + model breakdown first; keep additional dims optional.
- Alignment: prioritize correctness + reconciliation early; exports required for beta.

2026-01-15 — Scope adjustment
- Decision: ship table-first experience in beta; visualization polish can follow if it threatens timeline.
- Action: add explicit “data freshness” indicator in UI/API as a beta requirement.

2026-01-22 — Terminology
- Decision: UI copy should prefer “Endpoint (Route)” with tooltip; avoid assuming everyone knows ‘route’ semantics.
- Action: ensure docs explain canonicalization (templating IDs, OpenAI-compat endpoints).

2026-02-03 — Customer signal (HelioChat QBR)
- Top asks: weekly ‘what changed’, export for chargeback, and clarity on cache hit rate impacts.

2026-02-10 — Correctness emphasis
- Added reconciliation job/tests as GA gate; tolerance policy to be defined with Billing (Cole Summers).

2026-02-18 — Export/RBAC review
- Security requirement: audit log must include actor, workspace, time range, filters (where feasible), export job id, download event id.
- Decision: exports async by default for > 7 days to avoid request timeouts.

2026-02-28 — Current status
- Phase 1 in flight: aggregation + query API + initial UI table under feature flag.
- Next: finalize export CSV spec, close route normalization edge cases, and run reconciliation checks on beta accounts.

Comms / enablement
- Beta enablement via feature flag allowlist + internal checklist; support macro + known issues doc required before expanding.
- Release note draft planned for console-2026.03 beta window.
